Anthropic Features Overview: The Claude Model Family and Developer Tools

Anthropic is not a tool but the company that makes Claude. We separated what has been confirmed from what is still blank.

What this star does

Developing the Claude model family

It builds a model family with three names: Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku.

Safety research

It researches constitutional AI and interpretability.

Providing developer tools

It offers developer tools such as Claude Code.

In one line
The star's name tag is confirmed, but the gauge for deciding whether to use it is still empty. You need to fill in pricing, limits, and supported environments yourself from the official pages.

Who it suits

✓ Good fit for

· People who want to first sort out who makes Claude

· People unfamiliar with the names Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku

· People who want to verify the source of the developer tool Claude Code

✗ Look at a different star if

· You need to compare pricing and limits and decide right now → check the official pricing page directly

· You want to know performance and speed differences between models → not in this data, so check the official documentation

· You are curious about quality for Korean-language work → no directly verified data

3 first steps

Write down the task you want to solve in one lineIs it document work or development?
Check the products and current models on the official siteanthropic.com
Compare pricing, limits, supported environments, and data termsTest with a sample task that has no sensitive information

Frequently asked

Does Anthropic mean the same thing as Claude?No. Anthropic is the company that makes the Claude model family, and Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku are listed as the family's models.
What is Claude Code?It is confirmed as a developer tool provided by Anthropic. Specific features, installation methods, and supported environments are not in the data, so you need to check the official documentation separately.
Can I use Anthropic's AI for free?The data has no information on free usage scope or pricing. Check the current pricing and limits of the product you want to use on the official pricing page.
If they do safety research, is it okay to enter work materials?You cannot judge that from the fact that they do research alone. You need to separately check the product's data handling terms and your organization's policies.

A little more detail

How are Anthropic and Claude different?

Anthropic is the company, and Claude is the AI model family that company makes. In map terms, Anthropic is the observatory that forges stars, and Claude is the swarm of stars that came out of it.

The data classifies Anthropic as a 'frontier lab' and lists its sub-category as 'proprietary frontier lab'. You can read this as an organization that researches and develops cutting-edge AI models. Its one-line description is 'an AI safety company that makes the Claude model family'.

However, this classification does not guarantee performance on any particular task or the terms of use. That is why this card only says 'who makes what' and does not judge whether it is worth using. The company and its products are often mixed up because the names are similar, so start by reading them separately.

What features and activities are confirmed?

Three strands are confirmed. First, developing the Claude model family of Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku; second, safety research; third, providing developer tools such as Claude Code.

Safety research includes constitutional AI and interpretability. Constitutional AI refers to a safety research approach that makes use of principles for AI to follow, and interpretability refers to research that tries to understand how the inside of an AI works.

There is a line where we have to stop here. Only the fact that they do research is confirmed; specific results or the level of application in each product cannot be known. For the developer tool, only the name is confirmed, and its features and supported environments are blank. The same goes for differences in performance, speed, and cost among the three models.

What should I decide first in order to use it?

Decide the task you want to solve before the company name. The products and terms worth looking at differ depending on whether you want help with document work or with development work. This distinction is an example for review and does not mean we have confirmed that it supports those tasks.

If you are looking for a developer tool, the one to check is Claude Code. Its installation method, supported environments, and what it can do are not in the evidence, so you will need to open the official documentation.

Which of Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku to choose is also hard to decide with the current data. Only the names are known; differences in performance, response speed, and cost per model are not given. If you write down your task first, the items you need to look at on the official site shrink considerably.

How far have pricing and usage limits been confirmed?

The free tier, paid pricing, usage limits, and per-product terms of use are all missing from the source. Since all four items are blank, we can't say how far you can go for free or whether you need to move to a paid plan.

One point is easy to mix up. The date in the source, 2026-03-18, is the day this list was checked, not the day pricing was checked. It also doesn't mean the pricing at that time is still the same today.

So the only option is to check the guide and pricing page for the product you want to use directly on the official Anthropic website. Don't look at pricing alone; check the usage limits too.

Should you adopt it? Strengths, weaknesses, and the order to check things

The strength is that you can see the scope of its activities at a glance. We confirmed three pillars: developing model families, safety research, and providing developer tools. It is a usable starting point for understanding who makes Claude and Claude Code.

The weakness is that there isn't enough material to decide whether to use it. Korean-language task quality, differences between models, supported environments, and pricing and limits are all missing. Don't conclude that it's fine to enter work materials just because the company does safety research. Check the data handling terms and your organization's policies separately.

The order to check is this. Write down your task, look at the products and current models on the official website, and compare whether pricing, limits, supported environments, and data terms fit. Then test the results with a sample task that contains no sensitive information. For anyone who has to decide right away, we don't recommend choosing based on this source alone, and since there is no evidence on other tools to compare against, we don't recommend alternatives either.

What this star does

Enterprise language models and embeddings

A company that builds both LLMs that understand and generate text and embedding models that turn the meaning of text into numbers.

Command, tuned for RAG

A model specialized in RAG, an approach that finds relevant material and answers by referring to its contents.

Self-hosted deployment

An option to run it on your company's own servers (on-premises) or in an isolated cloud network (VPC).

In one line
A star worth shortlisting for owners who want to connect existing materials with AI and also consider self-hosted environments. However, search quality, Korean-language performance, and pricing have no supporting evidence and need to be verified directly.

Who it suits

✓ Good fit

· Owners reviewing how to connect internal documents with AI answers

· Organizations that need to run AI on their own servers or in an isolated cloud

· Teams that want to compare language models and embedding models from a single vendor

✗ Look at other stars instead

· Looking for a personal tool to try right now → sign-up and usage steps have no supporting evidence, so start with the official website

· Already decided on a cheap flat-rate plan → pricing information has no supporting evidence, so it can't be judged

First 3 steps

Decide the task to solve and the materials to connecte.g., searching internal work guidelines
Check search and answer quality with real Korean materialsLook at retrieval ability and explanation accuracy separately
Check models, pricing, and deployment terms on the official websitecohere.com

FAQ

What kind of AI company is Cohere?Based on the saved materials, it is a company that provides enterprise natural language processing and embedding models. It is recorded as developing enterprise LLMs and embedding models, offering the RAG-specialized Command model, and supporting on-premises and VPC deployment.
Can Cohere automatically connect internal documents?The RAG-specialized model and embedding model give grounds to consider a setup that finds existing materials and uses them in answers. However, the automatic connection process, supported storage, and file formats have no supporting evidence, so they must be checked separately on the official website.
Can Cohere be used for free?The free scope and paid pricing have no supporting evidence. The materials were checked on 2026-03-18, and current terms of use must be confirmed on the official Cohere website.

A bit more detail

What kind of star is Cohere?

Cohere is a company that builds language models and embedding models for enterprises. On the map, it sits in the Frontier Labs cluster, specifically in the Proprietary Frontier Labs orbit.

Let's briefly explain the terms first. NLP is technology that lets computers handle text and speech written or spoken by people. An LLM is a large language model that understands and generates sentences, and embedding is a method that turns the meaning of text into numbers so that texts with similar meaning can be found.

Three things are confirmed: development of enterprise LLM and embedding models, provision of the RAG-specialized Command model, and support for on-premises and VPC deployment. Personal sign-up screens and actual usage steps have no supporting evidence, so this article does not cover them.

What are the main observed features?

The features come down to four lines. First, enterprise language model development. When adopting it, you need to look at which models you can use and whether they fit your work.

Second, embedding model development. Since this model is the foundation of material search, the key thing to check is how good the search quality is on Korean materials.

Third, the Command model specialized for RAG. How it connects materials and how good the answer quality is must be checked by trying it yourself.

Fourth, support for on-premises and VPC deployment. The scope of support and operating conditions need to be asked about separately. The materials were checked on 2026-03-18, and the model version, processing limits, and scope of Korean-language support have no supporting evidence, so they were not confirmed.

Where should you start when connecting company materials to AI?

It's easier if you first distinguish the roles of RAG and embeddings. RAG is a method that first finds relevant materials and then builds an answer by referring to their contents. Embeddings can handle the "finding materials with similar meaning" part of that.

Typical use scenarios are having it find internal work guidelines to answer questions, or finding guidance documents related to customer inquiries. These are only examples to help understand the features, and do not mean that Cohere has been directly verified for such tasks.

The fact that Command is specialized for RAG is a reason to consider it. However, whether the connection is complete just by uploading materials, and which storage systems can be attached, cannot be confirmed from the evidence.

How much of self-hosted deployment and pricing is confirmed?

On-premises is a server environment that the company manages directly, and a VPC is a virtual private network separated off within the cloud. Support for both approaches is listed in the materials.

However, the fact that it is supported does not mean our company's security requirements are met. The applicable models, required equipment, data handling method, and operational responsibility must be checked separately.

Pricing is even more sparse. The free usage range, paid pricing, usage limits, and self-hosted deployment costs are all missing from the source material. Check current prices and contract terms on the official Cohere website. It is better to consider deployment and operating costs as well as model usage fees.

What are the strengths and limits, and where should an adoption review start?

The strengths are clear. Cohere builds both language models and embedding models, and the RAG-focused Command models and self-hosted deployment options are explicitly stated, so you can look at data connection and the deployment environment together.

The limits are also clear. There is no material verifying search accuracy, answer source display, Korean-language quality, setup difficulty, or cost. It is hard to conclude from a feature list alone that it fits your work well. If you are looking for a personal tool you can use right away or a confirmed low-cost service, the current material gives too little basis for choosing it. As alternatives, you can only treat managed AI services or self-operated models as comparison targets.

Start like this. First decide which task you want to solve, then plan how to check search and answer quality separately using real Korean-language material, and then confirm the current models, pricing, and deployment terms on the official website.

Try it free, and move to Pro if you hit the limits. If your data can't leave your environment, use a local model or Enterprise. If Korean quality is your top priority, test it first with a short text.

When to pick Mistral, and when to pick a neighboring star

Mistral
Company data can't leave the premises
It offers self-hosted installation and private deployment options.
Mistral
You want to run the model yourself

ChatGPT·Claude
Writing where Korean tone matters
Mistral is reported to perform worse in Korean than its competitors.
ChatGPT·Claude

Mistral's plugin and app ecosystem is reported to be smaller.

A 10-minute test route in the free orbit

Sign up quickly for the chat serviceStart with the Free plan
Ask the same question once in Korean and once in EnglishCompare the tone and accuracy of the answers side by side
Check the limit notes on the official pricing pageMessage and search limits go up from Pro
Read the license of the open model you plan to useWhether commercial use is allowed
Don't enter confidential or personal informationStick to light questions during testing

Frequently asked questions

Can I use Mistral AI for free?Based on a summary article checked on October 14, 2026, the Free plan gives you chat, access to the latest models, image generation, 500 memories, and 40+ enterprise connectors at no cost. Message and search limits are higher on Pro and above, and open models can also be run locally for free. Check the exact limits and pricing on the official pricing page.
Does Mistral AI support Korean?The languages the official site lists as supported are English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish, and a Korean interface has not been officially confirmed. The model answers Korean input, but Korean is not its main language, and some reviews say it performs worse than competitors.
Can a company install it on its own servers?On-premises and self-hosting options are described. The Enterprise plan is said to offer private deployment, custom models, custom UI, SAML SSO, audit logs, and white-label options. Details and costs need to be confirmed through official guidance.
Are Le Chat and Vibe different services?They are described as the same service under a new name. Around May 2026, Le Chat is said to have been renamed Vibe, an integrated work and coding agent. Older reviews refer to it as Le Chat, so include both names when you search.
Mistral AI cover image
5 things to check before you start
Mistral is a French AI company that offers both open models and a chat service

A closer look

What kind of star is Mistral, and who should board it?

The short answer: it is a star for people who cannot send their data outside, and for people who want to run models themselves. If your main job is polishing Korean documents smoothly, it drops down the priority list.

Mistral is the name used for the family of language models and the chat service built by the French AI startup Mistral AI. The company develops both open-weight models, whose weights are published so you can download and use them, and commercial models, and it also offers an option to install them on your own servers. It suits two kinds of people: corporate staff who find it hard to send internal data outside, and developers who want to run models directly or train them further. For general users who put Korean sentence quality first, it is hard to recommend as a first choice. The reasons are explained in the Korean section below.

What are the main features?

There are four main branches. They are the chat service, open models, advanced reasoning features, and a coding agent.

First, the chat service. Its former name was Le Chat, and it is described as having been renamed Vibe, an integrated work and coding agent, in May 2026. It is said to include a Work Mode that automates email, calendar, and document tasks. Second, open models. There are models by size, such as Mistral 7B, Mixtral 8x7B, Mistral Large, and Ministral, and descriptions say they can be run locally and fine-tuned, meaning further trained on your own data. Third, extended thinking and Deep Research reports, which open up on the Pro plan and above. Fourth, a coding agent mode that connects to GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Linear, and others to handle repository-level work. Image generation works by integrating Black Forest Labs' Flux family of models.

How far does the free orbit go, and how do I start?

The free tier gets you quite far. The limits are what block you. According to the summary article, the Free plan lets you use chat, access to the latest models, image generation, 500 memories, and 40+ enterprise connectors. Message and search limits are higher on Pro and above.

Monthly prices and limit figures were not in the material we gathered, so we have not listed them. Namuwiki also says the pricing explanation is very abstract, so check the limit notes directly on the official pricing page before paying. Getting started is simple: sign up for the chat service and try the Free plan. Besides the default model, there are said to be Think mode and Research mode. If you enter the same question once in Korean and once in English and compare the answers, you can gauge the Korean quality right away. Do not enter company secrets or personal information during testing.

Is it okay to use in Korean?

This is where opinions split the most. In the summary article, Korean performance that trails major competitors is listed as a drawback.

The languages the official site lists as supported are English, French, German, Italian, and Spanish, and a Korean interface (UI) is said not to be officially confirmed. The explanation is that the model does answer Korean input, but Korean is not its main language. Another summary collecting reactions from developers in Korea and abroad also reports repeated remarks about limits in reflecting subtle Korean nuance and cultural context. For work where tone matters, such as reports or blog posts, check the results with a few short texts first before deciding. On the other hand, for internal data processing or development tests where Korean quality does not matter much, this weakness carries less weight.

Can I run it on my own computer or company server, and what are the downsides?

You can run it. But the conditions differ by model. Models released as open source can be run locally for free, and descriptions say this suits places where data privacy matters. The computer specs needed differ by model size, so check the requirements before downloading. Namuwiki mentions that a small reasoning model runs on a single RTX 4090, but that is about one specific model.

At the company level, the Enterprise plan is said to offer private deployment, custom models, SAML SSO, audit logs, and more, and using it through clouds such as Amazon Web Services or Microsoft Azure is also described. A downside is the size of its ecosystem. Its plugins and apps are rated smaller than those of OpenAI and Google, so people who relied heavily on extensions for ChatGPT or Claude may find some features missing. Also, 'Mistral' is the name of the company, the models, and the service, and the service name changed from Le Chat to Vibe, so check whether older reviews are about the same service. Open weights also do not mean identical terms for every model. Some models are said to be restricted to research-purpose licenses, so if you plan to use one commercially, read each model's license separately. You can also find a basic introduction to this star on the Mistral introduction page.

✦ See this star on the 3D map
Sources: Moket AI's Mistral usage and pricing summary · Namuwiki's Mistral AI article · a Korean summary article on developer reactions · AI Galaxy Map's existing tool list · checked 2026-10-14. Pricing and limits change, so the numbers on the official page take priority.

27.title: How to Use Gemini for Free: A 10-Minute Walkthrough
27.body_html:
Beginner Navigator Guide · 10-Minute Course

How to Use Gemini for Free: A 10-Minute Walkthrough

Gemini carries the brain built by Google DeepMind. Three questions will tell you right away whether it fits you.

AI Cluster Map · 2026.10.14 · Checked 2026-10-14
KRW 0
Starting cost
Free orbit with just a Google account
5 times
Daily free limit for advanced models
Based on the Pro model and Deep Think
3 kinds
Paid plans
Plus · Pro · Ultra
Step 1 · Enter

Sign in to gemini.google.com with your Google account and agree to the terms. You must be 18 or older. On a phone, use the Gemini app on Android, or the Gemini tab in the Google app on iPhone.

Step 2 · Test it on your workTurn the memo below into a polite email draft to send to a client. Keep it within 3 paragraphs.

Paste in the content you actually need to send today. A task whose result you can judge right away works best.

Step 3 · Test latest informationDraft a time-by-time outline for a 2-day, 1-night trip near Seoul this weekend. Include one alternative for a rainy day.

Gemini's distinguishing feature is that it connects to Google Search and reflects up-to-date information. Look at how specific the answer is.

Step 4 · Test imagesA picture of a cat in a spacesuit drinking coffee on a yellow background

Image generation is included in the free plan. Video generation opens up starting with the paid plans.

Step 5 · Safety check

Do not enter resident registration numbers, passwords, financial information, or confidential company information. Conversations you have already had can be deleted from the My Activity page of your Google account.

Verdict
The moment when 5 advanced-model uses a day is not enough, or when you truly need video generation, is the signal to switch to a paid route. Until then, the free orbit is enough. If nothing blocked you within 10 minutes, keep using it for free.

Frequently asked questions

Can ordinary people use Google DeepMind directly?DeepMind is a research lab that builds models, so there is no separate app for ordinary people to use directly. Instead, the models DeepMind builds are inside services such as the Gemini chatbot, Veo video generation, and NotebookLM, so you can reach them through those.
Can I really use Gemini for free?Yes, it's free if you have a Google account. The Flash model can be used without usage limits, and image generation and Deep Research are included. However, the latest Pro model and Deep Think are limited to 5 times a day, and video generation opens only with paid plans.
Which paid Gemini plan should I choose?If you want to generate more images or write more documents, Plus at KRW 11,000/month is the starting point. If you need the Pro model, video generation (3 per day), and 5TB of storage, Pro is KRW 29,000/month. Ultra at KRW 300,000/month is for professionals and businesses who need the maximum limits. Before paying, be sure to check the plan details on the official screen.
Are the conversations I enter into Gemini safe?It is stated that Google may use conversations to improve its services and that some may be viewed by reviewers. It's best not to enter sensitive personal information or confidential company information. You can delete your activity history at any time on the My Activity page.
Gemini usage at a glance
Plan comparison (based on an introductory article checked on 2026-10-14)
Pre-start checklist card

A little more detail

A star built by DeepMind: where do we meet it?

The short answer: DeepMind is a lab that builds brains, and what we use are services that carry those brains. DeepMind is Google's AI research lab, responsible for developing the Gemini model family, science-focused AI such as AlphaFold, and putting AI into Google products across the board. AlphaFold is a research tool for predicting protein structures, so it is not something ordinary people install and use like an app. You can find the official introduction on the Google DeepMind site.

The closest entry point for ordinary people is the Gemini chatbot. It is described as handling conversation, writing, translation, and image generation, and as giving answers that reflect up-to-date information by connecting to Google Search. There are also integrations you can call up inside Gmail, Google Docs, Sheets, and Drive.

Veo handles video, and NotebookLM handles document-based answers. NotebookLM relies only on the PDFs or Google Docs you upload, so its sources tend to be clear. New experimental tools are gathered on the Google Labs experiments page. Developers can test prompts in Google AI Studio and get an API key, but that is not an area ordinary users need to touch.

How far does Gemini's free orbit extend?

You can start for free with just a Google account. Go to gemini.google.com, sign in, agree to the terms, and type your request into the input box, and that's it. There is a condition that only people aged 18 or older can use it. On Android, use the Gemini app on Google Play; on iPhone, use the Gemini tab inside the Google app.

The free plan uses the Flash model without usage limits and includes image generation, Deep Research, and Canvas. On the other hand, the latest Pro model and the Deep Think reasoning mode are limited to 5 times a day. Several articles agree that video generation is not included in the free tier and opens with paid plans.

Many people get confused by the name, but "Jaemini" and "Jemini" are the same service. Whichever you search for, Google's Gemini comes up.

What does the paid route cost to start?

In Korea, it starts at KRW 11,000/month (Plus). According to one introductory article (checked on October 14, 2026), Plus is KRW 11,000/month and adds 10 image generations per day and expanded email and document writing. Pro is KRW 29,000/month and includes the Pro model, Veo video (3 per day), and 5TB of storage, while Ultra is KRW 300,000/month with the maximum limits on all features, for professionals and businesses. Payment is made on the Google One site.

Some sources also disagree with each other. Another summary written as of April 2026 lists dollar prices (Pro $19.99/month, Ultra $249.99/month) and 2TB of storage, and calls the free tier "AI Plus." The names and configurations appear to differ by country and time.

So use the details on the screen right before payment as your standard. Even if the numbers change, the official pricing screen always takes priority.

What reefs are there before you set sail?

The first reef is privacy. It is stated that Google may use conversation content to improve its services and that some conversations may be viewed by reviewers. It's best not to enter resident registration numbers, passwords, financial information, or confidential company information. You can delete your activity history on the My Activity page. There is also a note that Gemini CLI, used in the terminal, may be used for training when used for free.

The second is long conversations. The wiki document relays user reviews saying that when a conversation gets very long, it tends to lose context. Keep in mind that this is a perceived impression, not an official figure. There is also advice that for tasks requiring logical reasoning, it's better to move to a new chat window.

The third is video. Veo is limited to up to 8 seconds per clip, and it is known that it may not interpret prompts accurately in complex scenes, or that audio in short speech segments may be less natural. Generated outputs include a SynthID watermark. If you don't need Google app integration and want to use GPT Store apps, ChatGPT may be the better fit.

What order should we set sail in today?

There's no reason to pay first. Go to gemini.google.com and give it one of your everyday tasks using a free account. Something whose result you can judge right away works best, like a draft of an email you usually write, the outline of a travel itinerary, or a summary of a long text.

If you run into specific frustrations within the free tier, that's when you can look at the pricing plans again. Which plan to pick depends on whether the 5 daily uses of the advanced model aren't enough or whether you need video generation. It's not too late to decide after using it for about a week.

This article is based on publicly available introductory articles and saved tool data, not on a hands-on review. Pricing and limits change often, so check the official page before paying. The information was checked on October 14, 2026.

✦ See this star on the 3D map
Sources: Google DeepMind official site (deepmind.google) · Google Gemini free usage and pricing plan overview (info.pleasedontbe.com) · Namuwiki Gemini · Complete Google AI overview (Digital Education Research Institute) · Google Labs · MoketAI Veo guide · Checked 2026-10-14. Pricing changes, so the numbers on the checkout screen take priority.

28.title: Stability AI Free Tier: Stable Diffusion and DreamStudio
28.body_html:
Newly Discovered Star · Visual Generation Cluster

Stability AI Free Tier: Stable Diffusion and DreamStudio

The model can be downloaded for free, while the web tool DreamStudio is pay-as-you-go with credits. Start by checking whether you have a GPU.

AI Cluster Map · 2026.10.14 · Checked 2026.10.14
Stability
Stability AI
Stability AI · Image generation model · Open-weight research lab · Stable Diffusion released 2022
Model free / DreamStudio pay-as-you-go credits (checked on the official pricing page)
Free

Local use requires a GPU
4 types
Editing features
Image-to-image, inpainting, outpainting, upscaling

How to use
Web tool, API, self-hosting

What this star does

Text → image

Describe a scene in text and it creates an image. The knack is to describe the subject, composition, style, and lighting.

Image → image, fixing parts

It refines a sketch or reference image, erases just a part and refills it, extends beyond the edges of the picture, and enlarges it.

Adjust values directly

You can tweak the seed, CFG scale, steps, sampler, and aspect ratio, which makes it easy to reproduce the same settings again.

Keep drawing the same character

It is described as good for keeping a character's identity consistent across many images when you train a LoRA on 10–20 character images.

Observation notes
The most widely used star in the open-weight cluster. That said, it is not the kind where you get a polished picture from a single line; it is a star you tame by tweaking values.

Who it suits

✓ Good for

· People who want to make thumbnails, social images, and product background drafts while adjusting them directly

· Developers and marketers who want to automate image generation

· People who want to try running it locally on a PC with a GPU

✗ Other stars suit these people better

· You want a polished result right away from a one-line input → comparisons say a hosted service like Midjourney is more convenient

· You have no GPU but are considering running it locally → start with the web tool

· You plan to upload personal information or confidential company images → not recommended

First 3 steps

Check whether your PC has a GPUIf not, use the web tool; if so, local is also an option
Create a DreamStudio account and check the pricing pageTrial credits vary by time and region
Try a short prompt for one or two images, with the seed fixed"A white mug by the window, morning sunlight, soft shadows"

Frequently asked questions

Is Stable Diffusion really free?The model weights can be downloaded and used for free. However, running it on your own computer requires a suitable GPU, and web-based services are offered separately on a free or subscription basis. Commercial use terms differ by model license and service terms, so check the official documentation.
How much does DreamStudio cost?The source material does not give a specific amount. It is described as pay-as-you-go using credits, with the deduction varying by model, resolution, and number of images generated. Whether trial credits are available also varies by time and region, so check the official pricing page.
Should I use Stable Diffusion instead of Midjourney?If you need fine control over results, local execution, or additional training, Stable Diffusion is the right fit. If you want polished results right away with a small prompt, comparisons say the hosted Midjourney is more convenient.
Does Stability AI make things other than images?The map's summary material says it also researches audio and video generation model families. Dedicated video models such as Stable Video Diffusion are described as an example of extending the image approach to video. Check the official site for the current range of offerings.
Stability AI featured image · Image: made in-house
Key points card · Image: made in-house
Highlight box · Image: made in-house

A little more detail

What kind of company is Stability AI?

It is an open AI company that makes image generation models such as Stable Diffusion and SDXL. On our map it is listed as an "open-weight and research lab" in the "frontier lab" category. Open-weight is an approach where a model's training result (the weights) is made public so anyone can download and use it.

Its research does not end with images but extends to audio and video generation model families. Its service forms are organized as an API (a channel for programs to exchange functions with each other) and self-hosting, meaning installing and using it directly on your own server or PC. The part ordinary users meet first is the image side.

The official introduction is available on the Stability AI official site.

What is the difference between Stable Diffusion and DreamStudio?

Stable Diffusion is the model, and DreamStudio is the window that lets you use that model on the web. In cooking terms, it is closer to the difference between a recipe and a restaurant.

Stable Diffusion is an open-source model released by Stability AI in 2022, and it creates images from text descriptions. It can also be downloaded and modified, so it has become the foundation of many AI tools. In exchange, running it on your own PC requires a suitable GPU. A detailed explanation is in the Morphic glossary.

DreamStudio is introduced as a web-based tool provided by Stability AI. The description says you can choose model versions such as SDXL and 1.5 in the browser without installing anything, and also use the developer API. However, this is based on a third-party introduction (AiTing introduction), so check the official site again for the current interface.

What can you actually ask it to do in image generation?

Creating new images from a text description alone is the basic feature, and it also covers editing existing images. The features described are image-to-image transformation (refining a sketch or reference image), inpainting (erasing only part and refilling it), outpainting (extending beyond the picture's edges), and upscaling (enlarging the size).

A distinctive point of the interface is that you directly control the seed, CFG scale, steps, sampler, and aspect ratio. If you fix the seed, it is easier to recreate results under the same settings, which makes it good for exploring a picture you like by changing it little by little.

Mentioned uses include advertising visuals, thumbnails, social images, product image backgrounds, and concept art drafts. When the same character must be drawn consistently across several images, making a LoRA (a small training file that additionally teaches a specific character or art style) from 10 to 20 character images is described as a standard technique.

Prompt example: "a white mug on a windowsill, morning sunlight, soft shadows, front-facing composition, photo-like texture". Elements you don't want are written separately in a negative prompt to exclude them.

How far can you use it for free?

The model itself is free. Stable Diffusion weights can be downloaded and used for free, and the cost comes back in the form of your own computer's GPU specs.

The web-based DreamStudio is described as pay-as-you-go, consuming credits, with the deduction varying by model, resolution, and the number of images made at once. Promotions that give trial credits when you create an account are sometimes offered, but the conditions are said to differ by time and region. The current allowance and prices are not given as numbers in the source material, so check the official pricing page.

There is one point that is easy to confuse. Other companies' services built on Stable Diffusion have a completely different pricing structure. For example, the Namuwiki article states that NovelAI gives newly registered accounts 30 free image generations, and after that you need to obtain a currency called Anlas through a subscription ($10, $15, or $25/month tiers) or a standalone purchase. This is not Stability AI's pricing, so don't mix them up.

Who is it a good fit for, and who is it not?

It suits people who want direct control over the output. Stable Diffusion allows customization through local execution, fine-tuning (additional training), and extensions, which sets it apart from hosted proprietary services like Midjourney. Conversely, the comparison material says Midjourney tends to produce polished-looking results right away without much effort on the prompt.

So it is useful for designers, marketers, and developers who want to automate an image pipeline, while the settings may be a burden for beginners who want a high-quality picture from a single line. If you are thinking of running it locally and have no GPU, this route is not for you.

We do not recommend uploading images containing personal information or internal company secrets. This is because how uploaded content is handled follows the official privacy policy. For commercial use, you need to separately check the model license, the terms of service, and third parties' copyrights, trademarks, and portrait rights.

How should you think about copyright?

If you plan to use it commercially, this is the part to read first. The Korean Wikipedia article "Music and artificial intelligence" states that copyright claims have been raised in large numbers over the generative technologies of Stability AI, OpenAI, Google, and others. There is also discussion that the scope of training data could change depending on the outcome of lawsuits (Wikipedia article). This article centers on music, so the details of image disputes need to be checked separately.

There is also an explanation that the ownership of AI-generated output is still being settled legally. For logos, specific characters, or images resembling real people, it is safer to check once more before using them.

What order is best for getting started?

Start by checking whether your PC has a GPU, because that decides your path. If it doesn't, start with the web tool; if it does, local installation also becomes an option.

If you go with the web, create a DreamStudio account, check whether trial credits are available and look at the pricing page, then try making just one or two images with a short prompt. If you write the subject, composition, style, and lighting and fix the seed, it is easy to compare what changed when you alter the conditions. There is an explanation that the latest SDXL is useful for realistic expression and fine detail, while 1.5 is useful for lightweight generation or repeating a specific style.

If you want to compare with other services, alternatives such as Canva, Dreamina, and Adobe Firefly are mentioned. However, this comparison article (Dreamina comparison article) was written by a competing service, so it is better to check figures such as free allowances separately on each official page.

This article is a summary of publicly available introductory materials, not a firsthand usage review.

✦ See this star on the 3D map
Sources: Stability AI official site (stability.ai) · Morphic glossary · AiTing DreamStudio introduction · Namuwiki NovelAI · Wikipedia · checked 2026-10-14. The DreamStudio description is based on a third-party introduction, so check pricing and features on the official screen.

29.title: Claude Pricing: How Far Does Free Go, and Do You Need Pro or Max?
29.body_html:
Orbit guide · Foundation model cluster

Claude Pricing: How Far Does Free Go, and Do You Need Pro or Max?

Start in the free orbit, and if you hit the limit often, move to Pro at $20/month. Max, the tier above, starts at $100/month.

AI Galaxy Map · 2026.10.14 · Pricing checked 2026-08-05
Free
Start right away on web or app
Usage limits only
$20/month
Pro, for individuals hitting the limit
Annual prepay of $200 also available
From $100/month
Max, a higher usage tier
5x or 20x Pro

What differs by orbit

Free
Light trial, occasional use
  • Start right away on web or app
  • Has usage limits
The most sensible next step
$20 /month ($200 annual prepay)
Individuals who need more usage than Free
  • More usage than Free
  • Pro limits also apply to Claude Code in the terminal
$100~ /month
People who often hit even the Pro limit
  • Usage tier 5x or 20x higher than Pro
Key takeaway so far
Start free → move to Pro if you hit the limit often. Choose Max only when you truly need 5x or 20x the usage of Pro. The multiplier is not a guaranteed number of questions; consumption varies with long conversations and large files.

When to pick Claude, when to pick a neighboring star

Claude
Reading and organizing long documents, structured writing, coding
It is reported to be strong in tasks that require precision and consistency.
ChatGPT
When you want information organized systematically
Some say ChatGPT may be a better fit if that is the feel you want.

10-minute test route in the free orbit

Open a new chat on the official web or appCheck that the app's developer is Anthropic before installing
Upload one long document and ask for a summary"First, summarize the whole thing in 5 sentences"
Have meeting notes organized into a table"Organize the meeting notes below into a table in the order of decisions, owner, and deadline. Leave blank anything not in the notes."
Check the limit indicatorSee the reset time shown on your account
If you hit the limit often, compare ProMonthly and annual totals and cancellation terms

Frequently asked questions

Can I use Claude for free?Yes, you can start with the Free plan on the official web and app. However, there are usage limits. When you reach the limit, opening a new chat may not reset it right away, so check the reset time shown on your account.
How much do Claude Pro and Max cost?As checked on August 5, 2026, Pro is listed at $20/month or $200 annual prepay, and Max starts at $100/month. Prices may vary by tax, region, and billing cycle, so the number on the checkout screen takes priority.
Does a Claude subscription include API usage fees?No. Web and app subscriptions and developer API usage are billed separately, and paying for a paid plan does not automatically add API credits.
Are my Claude conversations used for training?According to the official comparison table, personal Free, Pro, and Max users can opt out of model training use, and for the organizational Team plan, content is stated not to be used for training by default. Before handling company materials, check the settings screen for your plan.
Featured image · Image: made in-house
Comparison table · Image: made in-house
Key points card · Image: made in-house

A closer look

Who is Claude a good fit for, and what can it do?

If you often summarize long texts, write structured documents, or code, this is the right star for you. It is reported to be strong at work that demands precision and consistency, and its calm tone is also cited as a reason people prefer it.

On the other hand, it is not a star for creating images or videos directly. It helps with text work such as proposals and scripts.

On our map, it is recorded in the foundation model cluster as a model family specialized in long-document understanding and coding, with support for agentic coding (coding where the AI chains multiple steps together on its own) such as Claude Code. Inside the app, Projects bundle files and instructions so work continues to the same standard even when the conversation changes. Artifacts let you create notes, code, charts, and documents in a separate window and keep refining them, Research produces reports with sources attached, and Extended thinking handles deep analysis of multi-step tasks. With connectors, you can also link apps and data sources such as Microsoft 365 and Figma.

How much can I use for free, and how much does the paid plan cost?

A sensible order is to start free and move to a paid plan when you hit the limits often. You can start right away with Free on the official web and app, but there are usage limits.

As of August 5, 2026, Pro is listed at $20/month or $200/year paid upfront, and Max starts at $100/month. The actual charge may vary depending on tax, region, and billing cycle.

The multiplier shown for Pro and Max does not mean a fixed number of questions is guaranteed. Depending on long conversations, large files, and the model and features you choose, the same number of questions can use up different amounts of usage. When you hit the limit, opening a new conversation may not clear it right away, so check the reset time shown in your account. If re-uploading the same material in every conversation is a hassle, put it in a Project, and bundling your questions into one message helps save usage.

If I subscribe, can I use the API too?

No. Web and app subscriptions and developer API usage fees are billed separately. Paying for Pro does not add API credits.

If you are a developer who wants to build Claude into your own service, you need to consider the two costs separately. Budgeting based only on the subscription fee can easily go off track.

One more thing: there is guidance that when you use Claude Code in the terminal, the Pro plan's usage limits apply as they are. If you plan to hand off a lot of coding, you may use up your limit quickly, and that is when you would consider the higher-tier Max plan. Allowed usage and features differ by plan, so compare them based on what you want to do. The Research feature also has separate limit rules, so if you use it often, it is a good idea to read the official guidance once.

What are some practical ways to use it, and how do I get started?

Writing down the purpose, reference material, and desired output format together makes the results easier to review. If you uploaded a long report, start with "First, summarize the whole thing in 5 sentences," and then narrow your questions item by item.

Here is one sentence you can copy and use. "Organize the meeting notes below into a table in the order of decisions, owner, and deadline. Leave blank anything that is not in the notes." Thanks to the last line, you can reduce the chance of the AI filling in blanks with plausible-sounding content.

Opening a new conversation on the official web or app is enough to get started. There are other apps with similar names for smartphones, so check that the developer is Anthropic. For desktop support, the official screen shows the current status most accurately. After signing up, try handing it the one task you usually find most tedious. If the free limit is enough, there is no reason to pay, and if you hit it often, that is when you can compare Pro's monthly and annual billing and mid-term cancellation terms.

When should I be careful, and how do I choose between this and other stars?

Before uploading company secrets or personal information, check the plan's data policy first. According to the official comparison table, personal Free, Pro, and Max users can opt out of having their data used for model training, while the organizational Team plan is described as not using content for training by default. The fact that the defaults differ is easy to confuse.

Real-time information is a weak point. It is reported to have limits in checking recent issues or real-time data on its own, so if freshness matters, attach the relevant material. It cannot access files or accounts that you have not uploaded or connected. Some users say that having it review a novel manuscript with mature content ran into its safety standards, but that is a personal assessment, so it is better to test it once with your own work.

If you value the texture of the writing and mostly work with long documents and coding, try Claude first. Some say ChatGPT may suit you if you want the feeling of having information organized systematically, and many users split their use by task. Pricing changes often, so open the official ChatGPT pricing page and Claude's official pricing guide on the same day to compare. You can see its category and basic information on the Claude overview page.
